run_speech_synthesis_inference: run speech-to-speech translation inference from discrete codes to generate audio wav files using a checkpoint
run_multi_gpu_inference: run parallel multi-GPU inference on a dataset of speech codes using multiprocessing pool workers
run_single_speaker_inference: run single speaker speech synthesis inference with duration prediction on a code file
run_multi_speaker_inference: run multi-speaker speech synthesis inference generating audio for multiple random speakers from codes
run_debug_inference: run debug mode inference on a limited number of samples with a progress bar
